notes: eFootball-style context controls. Slots are fixed positions (normalised 0..1; size = diameter as a fraction of min(width, 2 x height), then x the player's button-size setting). With the ball: tl THROUGH, tr SHOOT, bl PASS, br DASH, s1 LOFT (CLEAR in own third), s2 SKILL, s3 1-2 (pass and run). Without the ball: tl TEAM PRESS, tr SWITCH, bl PRESS (hold), br DASH, s1 TACKLE.
